title: Task 3: Make Desired-State Planning Unit-Aware
intent: Desired-state planning carries deployment-unit identity, groups environment plans by unit, rejects cross-unit Compose dependencies, and computes deterministic unit and environment revision hashes.
observed_before: DesiredServiceSpec only identified service/environment/artifact, and DesiredEnvironmentPlan computed one flat environment hash from service hashes.
intended_behavior: Planning normalizes implicit default-unit services, preserves explicit unit identity, computes per-unit revision hashes, aggregates environment revision from units, and fails plan assembly when Compose dependencies cross units.
